title: 第17章 修为核验深藏不露第18章 功法演武稳显根基
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 演武场上气氛肃然紧绷。
白发长老话音落下之后，全场参赛弟子尽数屏息凝神。
目光齐齐望向广场中央的核验区域，心头暗自紧张。
第一轮修为核验，是最硬性的门槛。
达不到炼气三层修为，直接当场淘汰，连后面功法演武和擂台比试的机会都没有。
不少自忖修为堪堪达标的弟子，手心暗自攥紧，神情忐忑不安。
外围散修、各处山脚投奔而来的少年修士，还有后山赶来的杂役弟子。
所有人都排成整齐队列，按次序等候上前核验。
负责核验的是两名宗门执事，神情淡漠，不苟言笑。
身前摆放着测灵石，通体灰白，温润沉静，是宗门用来检测修士修为的常用器物。
只需把手按在测灵石上，引动体内灵力，便能显现境界。
流程简单，结果直观，半点弄虚作假不得。
广场四周的观礼石阶上。
坐满了外门乃至内门的弟子，三三两两闲谈观望。
眼神带着几分居高临下的淡然，把这场纳新考核当成闲来无事的消遣。
在他们眼中，这些底层修士资质平平，根基浅薄，大多难成大器。
能勉强通过考核踏入外门，已是极限。
真正能脱颖而出、被长老看中破格栽培的，寥寥无几。
后山杂役队伍列队站在一侧，人人神情紧绷。
平日里在后山劳作修行，彼此还能暗自攀比。
如今汇聚整个宗门周边的年轻修士，才真切感受到天外有天，人外有人。
不少弟子看着前方陆续上前核验的参赛者，心底越发没底。
轮到靠前的修士上前，抬手按在测灵石上。
灵力涌动之间，石身泛起淡淡的白光。
执事扫了一眼，淡淡开口。
“炼气二层，未达门槛，淘汰。”
话音落下，那名少年脸色瞬间苍白，垂头丧气退到一旁。
满脸失落与不甘，却又无可奈何。
接下来接连数人上前核验。
有侥幸达到炼气三层，顺利通过，当场松了口气，满脸欣喜。
也有差上一线，卡在二层巅峰，遗憾离场。
淘汰者神情落寞，过关者暗自庆幸。
一轮轮核验下来，场上已然刷落不少人。
残酷的筛选，从一开始就毫不留情。
杂役队伍里，几名自认修为不错的弟子，陆续上前排队。
有人顺利测出炼气三层，安然退到过关人群之中。
也有人满怀信心上前，最终黯然淘汰。
人群之中，赵虎面色紧绷，静静等候。
他修为稳稳停留在炼气三层，底气还算充足。
只是眼角余光时不时瞟向队伍末尾的林宸，心底始终有些发虚。
他始终看不透林宸的深浅，总觉得对方藏着莫测实力。
content_en:
The atmosphere in the martial arts arena was solemn and tense.
After the white-haired elder finished speaking, all the participating disciples held their breath and concentrated.
They all looked at the verification area in the center of the square, feeling secretly nervous.
The first round of cultivation verification is the hardest threshold.
Those who fail to reach the third level of Qi refining will be eliminated on the spot without even the chance to perform martial arts and compete in the ring later.
Many disciples who thought their cultivation was not up to standard secretly clenched their hands and looked uneasy.
Loose cultivators from the outside, young monks from all over the mountains came to seek refuge, and handyman disciples from the back mountains.
Everyone lined up neatly and waited in order to come forward for verification.
The people responsible for the verification were two sect deacons with indifferent expressions and serious expressions.
There is a spirit-testing stone placed in front of him. It is gray-white, warm and calm. It is a common instrument used by the sect to test the cultivation of monks.
Just press your hand on the spiritual stone and activate the spiritual power in your body to reveal your realm.
The process is simple, the results are intuitive, and no fraud is allowed.
On the stone steps surrounding the square.
The seats were filled with disciples from the outer sect and even the inner sect, chatting and watching in groups.
With a somewhat condescending indifference in his eyes, he regarded this new recruitment assessment as an idle pastime.
In their eyes, these low-level monks have mediocre qualifications and shallow foundations, and most of them are unlikely to become great people.
Being able to barely pass the exam and step into the outer gate is already the limit.
There are only a few who can really stand out and be favored by the elders for cultivation.
The team of handymen in the back mountain lined up and stood on one side, everyone looked tense.
On weekdays, they work and practice in the back mountains, and they can secretly compare themselves with each other.
Now that all the young monks around the sect have gathered together, they can truly feel that there is heaven outside the world and there are people outside the world.
Many disciples looked at the contestants who came forward one after another for verification, and their hearts became more and more uncertain.
It was the monk at the front's turn to step forward and put his hand on the spirit-testing stone.
As spiritual power surged, the stone body glowed with a faint white light.
The deacon glanced at it and spoke calmly.
"The second level of Qi Refining has not reached the threshold and will be eliminated."
As soon as the words fell, the young man's face instantly turned pale, and he stepped aside dejectedly.
His face was full of loss and unwillingness, but he was helpless.
Then several people came forward to check.
I was lucky enough to reach the third level of Qi Refining and successfully passed. I was relieved on the spot and my face was full of joy.
There are also cases where they are just short of reaching the top line, stuck at the peak of the second level, and regretfully leave the game.
Those who were eliminated looked lonely, while those who passed were secretly grateful.
After rounds of verification, many people have been removed from the field.
Brutal screening, no mercy from the beginning.
In the team of handymen, several disciples who thought they were good at cultivation came forward one after another to line up.
Someone successfully tested the third level of Qi Refining and retreated safely among the people who passed the test.
Some people stepped forward with full confidence, but were ultimately eliminated sadly.
Among the crowd, Zhao Hu looked tense and waited quietly.
His cultivation level is firmly at the third level of Qi Refining, and his confidence is quite sufficient.
From the corner of his eye, he glanced at Lin Chen at the end of the team from time to time, feeling a little weak in his heart.
He could never see through Lin Chen's depth, always feeling that the other party had hidden unfathomable strength.
title_en: Chapter 17: Cultivation verification is hidden Chapter 18: Kung Fu and martial arts show solid foundation
